goal: Add per-address connection limits to -ipcbind and integrate them into node file descriptor accounting
Prevents node crashes or denial of service caused by file descriptor exhaustion
Lets node operators configure different limits for listeners serving different roles
reviewability: Review is worthwhile now with no open objections or blockers
agreement: Strong support for fixing descriptor accounting gaps and adding per-address limits (ryanofsky)
Verified by testing connection limits and client backlog behavior on Linux and macOS (xyzconstant)
Concept approval citing cleaner configuration and extensibility for listeners (kevkevinpal, Sjors)
Earlier concerns regarding integer overflows, path escaping, and logging were resolved

categories.name: ipc
why: P2 because it prevents crashes and denial of service risks from IPC file descriptor exhaustion
Closes an accounting gap during node startup while enabling flexible limits across listeners
